Name: Charlotte Mine Retexture
Author: lyneyy
Description:
[size=5]Description[/size]
Turn Skull Cavern into the den of Charlotte, the Dessert Witch. This [i]Puella Magi Madoka Magica[/i]-inspired Content Patcher pack reimagines four of the cavern's monsters as Charlotte and her familiar Pyotr. It only changes monster appearances — it doesn't alter the cavern's maps or gameplay.
Installation instructions
[list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI 4.0.0 or newer and Content Patcher.[/*]
[*]Extract the ZIP file into your[/*]
[/list]
[code]Stardew Valley/Mods[/code]folder, keeping the
[code][CP] Charlotte Mine Retexture[/code]folder intact.
3. Launch the game through SMAPI.

[size=5]Main features[/size]
[list]
[*]Serpent and Royal Serpent become Charlotte's true form.[/*]
[*]The dangerous variant of the Armored Bug becomes Charlotte's candy-doll form. This version only appears while Skull Cavern's special challenge mode is active.[/*]
[*]Iridium Bat becomes Charlotte's familiar, Pyotr. Iridium Bats start appearing from floor 51 of Skull Cavern onward.[/*]
[/list][size=5]Requirements[/size]
[list]
[*]SMAPI 4.0.0 or newer[/*]
[*]Content Patcher[/*]
[/list][size=5]Credits[/size]
This is an unofficial, non-commercial fan mod inspired by [i]Puella Magi Madoka Magica[/i]. All rights to the original characters and designs belong to Magica Quartet / Aniplex / SHAFT. This mod is not affiliated with or endorsed by the rights holders. All artwork in this mod was created by me.
Built with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] by Pathoschild, for [url=https://www.stardewvalley.net]Stardew Valley[/url] by ConcernedApe.
